Per §7's curtailed-bar guidance, the LARGER printed count for each face is kept as that face's main_bar count (the real total bar count used), with a note recording which section showed which reading, rather than picking only one section's numbers or averaging.
B1 prints only one section (symmetric top=bottom=2-DB12) — no SECTION_2-2 on this sheet for that mark.

RB2 (the roof-overhang ring beam) is 150 mm wide x 300 mm deep with tighter stirrup spacing (@0.15) than every other mark on this sheet (@0.20) — double-checked against the printed dimension brackets, not a copy-paste of the other beams' 150x400.
